I found official online content for Alex Xu’s **System Design Interview**:

- **[Contents of Volumes 1 and 2](https://blog.bytebytego.com/p/system-design-interview-books-volume)**, published by Alex Xu.
- **[Read: Scale From Zero to Millions of Users](https://bytebytego.com/courses/system-design-interview/scale-from-zero-to-millions-of-users)**. Readable without signing in when checked.
- **[Read: Design a Rate Limiter](https://bytebytego.com/courses/system-design-interview/design-a-rate-limiter)**. Also readable without signing in when checked.
- **[Official online course](https://bytebytego.com/courses/system-design-interview)**. Some content requires payment: selecting “Stock Exchange” redirected to a pricing page displaying “Unlock Full Access.”

**[Download the chapter lists and reading links](outputs/alex-xu-system-design-guide.md)**.

This is not the full text of the books. I did not establish a free, authorized download of the complete books.
